scope: Submitted composer acknowledgement clearing only; excludes stale task insertion/navigation and Changes request ordering
verified_design: All production composer writers replace the ComposerDraft object and attachment arrays.
Identity guards protect edits and A-B-A revisions without blocking clearing after an unrelated composer edit.
Existing generation changes on connect/disconnect and protects retained objects across project lifecycle changes.
Missing composer map entries are not recreated by old acknowledgements.
Acknowledgement clearing preserves lastComposer; normal explicit task navigation remains unchanged.
CodeMirror store-origin updates are annotated and do not spuriously create a new composer revision.
Commands receive submitted content; later edits do not change Home history.
Failed command and transport acknowledgements preserve drafts.
limitations: Reviewer did not run broad frontend checks, browser E2E or native application; parent is completing those.
Existing messageEditing error-path fixtures emit expected notification logs; test processes exited 0.
